value.rationale: The first possible eight-point adaptive-depth-three self-restricted induced systems in a canonical finite-field distance graph form a natural sharp finite classification. The 2050 support count, twelve symmetry types and root multiplicities distinguish online realizations beyond the known ambient static and online dimensions and identify minimal finite representatives of a VC/Littlestone gap. This is neither an arbitrary numerical slice nor a straightforward corollary of prior theorems.
